hotels.title: Missouri Downtown St. Louis Art Hotel with Onsite Museum, Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Surrounded by the creative pulse of Washington Avenue, this stylish hotel is where contemporary art meets historic grandeur in the heart of downtown St. Louis. Discover over 14,000 square feet of curated exhibition space, where thought-provoking installations transform every corridor into a living gallery. Treat yourself to Spanish flavours at the acclaimed Idol Wolf restaurant and sip on expertly roasted coffee at Good Press. For total relaxation, take a dip in the indoor lap pool or head straight to the spa for indulgent treatments and massages. When the city calls, explore the vibrant Delmar Loop entertainment hub or catch a show at the nearby Fox Theatre.
